verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe integrations with three issue trackers: Jira (docs-3), GitHub (docs-16) and Linear (docs-17). Each creates HumanLayer agent tasks directly from tickets or issues and links artifacts back to the source, and Linear also syncs issue status. Tasks then group the agent sessions that do the work (docs-5). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that ticket-to-task assignment works as described.
